findings.claim: Because 18:5 denies knowledge to both the speakers and their forefathers while their saying still reaches falsehood, the ayah exposes missing provenance as well as false content.
findings.mechanism: The attributed HFT trace links denied disclosure, the ancestral channel, belief-like saying, and contradiction of truth through the exact focus occurrences, so inherited assertion has no supplied route from knowledge to speech.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the claim fail not only at its destination but also at the sources it presents as authority.
findings.containment: This is an attributed HFT resonance with legacy-unbound provenance; it does not invent a branch gloss, establish historical transmission, or replace the ordinary falsehood reading.

epistemic.reason: The trace is exact and focus-aligned, but its reader identity is explicitly legacy_unbound, so the synthesis remains attributed.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: babalık, besleyip yetiştirme ve oluşuma ya da iyileşmeye kaynaklık etme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kimsenin baba olması, babalık ilişkisi taşıması veya baba soyunu temsil etmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The forefather form carries the supplied fatherhood and lineage meaning.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The opening knowledge noun is placed under exhaustive denial.
branch_activations.activation: The lineage carrier meets the denied-knowledge trigger, so ancestry cannot function as an independent warrant source.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The ancestral channel is present as a possible support for the claim but is itself without supplied knowledge.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the supplied fatherhood/lineage core is retained; upbringing and source extensions are not independently asserted.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The claim lacks direct disclosure before it is voiced.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed trace does not activate every associated teaching or informing use of the root.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam, bir görüş veya inancı benimsemektir.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: An unsupported assertion has hardened into a transmitted position.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed reading does not claim a specific creed, sect, or independent doctrine beyond the supplied focus trace.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Doğruluğa aykırılık hem söylenen bir sözde hem de yapılan bir davranışta gerçekleşebilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The final falsehood noun carries contradiction of truth in speech.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The claim is voiced despite the preceding denial of knowledge and inherited warrant.
branch_activations.activation: The falsehood carrier meets the provenance failure and saying triggers, so the final verdict audits the route as well as the content.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The speech is false in content and unsupported in origin.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed trace does not extend the result to every false action or label the speakers beyond this speech.

findings.title: A heavy word crosses a bodily threshold
findings.claim: The ayah stages the grave utterance as a heavy, discrete object whose demonstrated route is outward through a bodily opening.
findings.mechanism: The attributed HFT trace joins the heavy-force, word-unit, exit, mouth-opening, and spoken-output branches through exact focus occurrences, making vivid oral production contrast with absent knowledge.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the unsupported claim as something carried from mouth to outside rather than from knowledge to speech.
findings.containment: This is an attributed HFT synthesis with legacy-unbound provenance; it does not invent a branch gloss or claim that bodily vividness itself supplies warrant.

epistemic.reason: The trace is exact and focus-aligned, but its reader identity is explicitly legacy_unbound, so the synthesis remains attributed.
